## Service area
Palm Beach County and Broward County, from West Palm Beach to Broward County. Customers should share their city or ZIP and confirm coverage for the specific service and schedule.

## Services
Home cleaning, recurring cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, Airbnb and short-term rental turnover cleaning, office and commercial cleaning, yacht interior cleaning, boat washdowns and deck cleaning, and kosher-friendly kitchen cleaning by household-directed checklist.

## Notes
Kosher-friendly describes a client-directed cleaning checklist, not religious certification, supervision or kashering. The site does not publish a street address. Do not infer an exact service radius, office location, business hours, pricing, licenses, certifications or review score. Contact Clino to confirm details for a specific property.
